subject: Annual committed spend: remittance bank change / VAT treatment for multi-entity invoicing
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@lukasfin.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: accounting@lukasfin.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0500
Subject: Remittance change + VAT for annual prepay invoicing

Hi Aisha,

Quick heads up from our side — our treasury has changed the remittance bank for all UK/DE entities effective immediately. We have an open committed-spend contract with Redwood (DL-2026-0917-LUK) that covers our annual prepay. Two asks from finance: 

1) Can your invoices for the upcoming tranche be split by legal entity (LukasFin UK Ltd and LukasFin GmbH) so we can apply our local VAT reclaim flows?
2) Can you reissue the November invoice to the new wire account? We can sign an updated remit instruction and attach VAT registration docs.

We’re conscious vendors often need PO acceptance/format to map invoices properly — happy to share a PO if you confirm the correct invoice header.

Attaching our new wire stub and consolidated VAT certs (zipped).

Thanks,
Elena
Finance Manager
Lukas Financial
[Attachment: wire_instructions_update.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: Lukas_EU_VAT_certificates.zip (ZIP)]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@lukasfin.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:01:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Remittance change + VAT for annual prepay invoicing

Elena — thanks for the note and the attachments, got them. Short answer: yes, we can support entity-split invoices and update the remit account, but we need to coordinate a small set of ops steps so we don’t break the committed-spend drawdown ledger. Proposed plan below (high level):

- Confirm invoice headers (company name, legal address, VAT ID) for each entity — please confirm LukasFin UK Ltd (GB) and LukasFin GmbH (DE) details.
- We will generate separate invoices for the November tranche (two invoices) and tag them to the same deal ID for internal accounting.
- Because this is a mid-cycle remit change, Finance (cc’d: karthik_iyer) needs to approve the updated wire details and process a one-time debit memo flow if any prepay allocation shifts are required.
- Please provide the PO number you mentioned and indicate which entity the PO is issued to.

Kimberly — can you confirm whether Legal/Finance needs an MOU for the remit account change or whether our standard remit update form is sufficient?

Elena — I’ll create a short mutual action plan and send the draft invoices for review within 48 business hours once we confirm headers and PO.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: draft_debit_memo_sample.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:33:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Remittance change + VAT for annual prepay invoicing

Aisha / Karthik — quick internal note before we send external-facing docs: 

- For EU VAT we prefer invoices to match the entity that holds the VAT registration so clients can reclaim VAT cleanly. Splitting is fine; we’ll need to ensure our tax clearing bucket maps correctly in the ledger.
- Because this is an active committed-spend contract, any invoice reallocation that reduces available prepay balance on a per-entity basis must be reflected in the drawdown tracker. Marissa, can you update the tracker once we issue the split invoices?
- On debit memos: we can use a debit memo only if there’s an actual correction to a previously billed tranche (e.g., misapplied VAT). If it’s just a remit update + split by entity, generate new invoices and annotate them as tranche Xb/Xc rather than creating credit/debit entries that touch recognized revenue.

Action items (internal):
1) Aisha: collect legal headers + PO from Lukas by EOD Wed (11/11).
2) Karthik: confirm wire validation checklist and provide sign-off for finance change.
3) Marissa: be ready to update drawdown tracker and attach a short note explaining why split occurred.

If all good I’ll approve the remit update for Ops to send.

—Kimberly
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@lukasfin.com>, aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Remittance change + VAT for annual prepay invoicing

Elena / Team — thanks for the patience. I’ve validated the wire instruction sample and the VAT documents you uploaded. Two confirmations from Finance: 

1) We will issue two invoices for the November tranche: one to LukasFin UK Ltd (GB VAT ID: GB999999999) and one to LukasFin GmbH (DE VAT ID: DE123456789). Please confirm these exact legal names and VAT IDs in your reply (we will not proceed without exact match).
2) No debit memo will be issued — we will treat this as a reroute + split for the upcoming tranche only. The drawdown tracker will be updated (Marissa will post the change + note).

Next steps for Lukas: reply-all with: PO number, confirmation of the two legal headers (exact casing and punctuation), and the preferred invoice remit date (if different from our standard Nov 15 tranche date). Also, confirm you accept the amended invoice PDF format (we’ll include full VAT line-by-line).

I’ve attached the quick wire checklist used for bank validation. Once we have your confirmation we’ll send the two PDFs with new remit details within 24 business hours.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: bank_validation_checklist.pdf (PDF)]
